hero.description: Discover the gaps in your political brand and get a personalized action plan from Polibrand.
hero.title: Political Readiness Index (PRI)

questions.text: When a key political opportunity arises — a nomination, endorsement, or high-stakes appointment — what is your honest reality?

options.text: My name is rarely in the conversation. I'm not visible to the people who make these decisions.
I'm occasionally mentioned, but I lose out to candidates with stronger, more recognisable brands.
I get opportunities, but I'm not yet seen as the obvious, first-choice leader.
I attract opportunities, but I need a strategic partner to maximise and scale them.
I'd struggle. I don't yet have a sharp, compelling message that cuts through.
I'd get through it, but it wouldn't be memorable or leave a strong impression.
I'd do well — but my pitch isn't consistent and doesn't scale beyond one-on-one conversations.
I deliver it confidently — but I need help amplifying it to the audiences that matter most.

questions.text: If a powerful decision-maker asked you to pitch your political vision in 60 seconds right now — what would happen?

options.text: I honestly don't know — I haven't built enough presence for people to be talking about me.
They might say I'm capable, but they likely can't define what I uniquely stand for.
They respect me — but others are shaping my narrative before I get the chance to.
They associate me with strong work, but my brand isn't yet commanding the rooms I want.

questions.text: When political stakeholders discuss you in rooms you're not in, what do you believe they say?
What is your most pressing political challenge right now?

options.text: I'm figuring out my positioning — I know I'm meant for this, but I need a clear strategy.
I'm preparing for an election or major role and need to be competitive, fast.
I'm in the public eye but losing ground to candidates with bolder, more polished brands.
I'm established — and I need to build a legacy brand that outlasts my current position.

foundersStory.title: The Polibrand Story
foundersStory.story: Polibrand was born from a simple observation: African political leaders had the vision and the courage to drive change, but lacked the strategic communication frameworks to command the political attention their ideas deserved. Working across West African democracies, we watched brilliant candidates, policymakers, and advocates struggle to translate their political acumen into the disciplined brand positioning that shapes electoral outcomes and institutional influence. We decided to change that.
